fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: A user-specified, human-readable name for the `WorkerPool`.

fields.label: Private Service Connect
fields.help: Private Service Connect configuration for the pool.

fields.label: Worker Config
Disk Size Gb
fields.help: Size of the disk attached to the worker, in GB.

fields.label: Enable Nested Virtualization
fields.help: Enable nested virtualization on the worker, if supported by the machine type.

fields.label: Machine Type
fields.help: Machine type of a worker, such as `n1-standard-1`.

fields.label: No External IP
fields.help: If true, workers are created without any public address, which prevents network egress to public IPs.
Configuration to be used for a creating workers in the `WorkerPool`.
